title: 7408 AND Gate Circuit
description: Dual-input TTL logic gate with LED truth table verification

steps.instruction: Insert 7408 IC spanning center trough with pin 1 notch facing left (rows E10-F10)

hints.missing: Place the 7408 quad AND gate IC across the center divider trough.
hints.wrong_position: Align pin 1 with row 10 spanning the center trough.
hints.reversed: Flip the IC: notch must face towards column 1 (left).

steps.instruction: Connect VCC (Pin 14 / row E10) to +5V rail and GND (Pin 7 / row F16) to ground (-)

hints.missing: Add power wire from +5V to IC pin 14 (row E10).
hints.safety_violation: Power pin reversed! Check VCC vs GND pins.

steps.instruction: Connect logic inputs A and B to Pins 1 & 2 (rows E16 & E15)

hints.missing: Connect input jumpers to gate 1 inputs on pins 1 and 2.
hints.wrong_position: Ensure inputs are connected to rows E15 and E16.

steps.instruction: Connect output (Pin 3 / row E14) through 220Ω resistor to LED anode

hints.missing: Insert 220Ω resistor between output pin 3 and LED anode.
